technical.title: AI agents teach robots like Microduck to walk in simulation
technical.summary: Robotics researchers use AI agents and simulation environments to teach walking policies, perception, and balance to robots navigating obstacle courses.
technical.why: It directly applies to autonomous systems and robotics engineering workflows.

technical.title: EvalResearchBench introduces autonomous evaluation research for recursive self-improvement
technical.summary: EvalResearchBench allows AI agents to automate evaluation design by selecting tasks, implementing graders, and testing them within fixed budgets to support recursive self-improvement.
technical.why: It matters because automating evaluation design reduces the high cost of running complex benchmarks during recursive self-improvement.

technical.title: LLM agents disclose confidential information via the mosaic effect
technical.summary: Researchers quantified confidentiality leaks in LLM agents and found that even top-performing models like GPT-5.6-Sol disclose forbidden conclusions assembled from separate accessible documents.
technical.why: It highlights critical security risks when deploying LLM agents over confidential enterprise or military data.

technical.title: Microsoft open-sources Agensh multi-agent harness scaling up to 1,024 agents
technical.summary: Microsoft Research released Agensh, a decentralized multi-agent harness where self-organizing workers share a Git repo and findings board to scale up to 1,024 agents.
technical.why: It offers a decentralized architecture for scaling large multi-agent engineering workloads without an orchestrator.

technical.title: NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 introduces the Global Performance Tuner for optimization
technical.summary: The Global Performance Tuner feature in NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 enables automatic, accuracy-aware performance optimization beyond a single build route.
technical.why: It helps computer vision and AI engineers automatically maximize inference performance across models.

technical.title: Amazon SageMaker guide details multi-turn reinforcement learning pipelines
technical.summary: A hands-on guide walks through training models on multi-step tasks using multi-turn reinforcement learning on Amazon SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore.
technical.why: It provides a practical implementation blueprint for training complex agentic workflows.

technical.title: ID-TAP framework enables test-time personalization for LLM agents using dueling bandits
technical.summary: ID-TAP combines a neural utility model with a Bradley-Terry explorer to adapt LLM agents to user preferences through binary response comparisons.
technical.why: It provides a scalable approach for query-dependent test-time agent personalization over large persona spaces.

technical.title: Nanbeige releases a 33B open agentic coding model with 512K context
technical.summary: Nanbeige LLM Lab released Nanbeige4.3-33B, a dense Apache 2.0 model featuring a 512K context window and strong performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
technical.why: It offers an open-weight alternative for engineering coding and agentic workflows.

technical.title: Cognition open-sources Devin vulnerability fixes plugin for secure deployments
technical.summary: Cognition released three MIT-licensed agent skills that inventory, patch, and test PHP, Node.js, and GitLab deployments against critical remote code execution flaws.
technical.why: It provides ready-to-use agent tools for automating cybersecurity patching workflows.

technical.title: OpenAI details scaling of online storage to serve ChatGPT users
technical.summary: An architectural review outlines how OpenAI scaled Habitat using multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver faster reads for ChatGPT.
technical.why: It offers valuable scaling insights for engineers building high-throughput production AI applications.

business.title: Turmoil Hits AI Buildout As Neoclouds Face Pressure And Solidigm Pulls IPO
business.summary: Stock slumps, pulled IPOs, and rising spreads on credit default swaps set the stage for hyperscaler earnings.
business.why: Financial stress in cloud infrastructure directly threatens the hardware supply chain for heavy compute workloads.

business.title: OpenAI Nears Up To $30 Billion Funding Round At $1.25 Trillion Valuation
business.summary: OpenAI is close to finalizing a new funding round meant as a bridge to its 2027 IPO, led by UAE investors.
business.why: Massive capital injections into major AI labs signal continued high-stakes industry scaling.

business.summary: The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest.

business.summary: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has been tracking global data center development for years. The US has a lot to learn from what’s happened everywhere from Ireland to New Zealand.

business.title: Tenstorrent And Flapping Airplanes Lead The Week's Biggest AI Funding Rounds
business.summary: AI processor developer Tenstorrent and AI lab Flapping Airplanes secured the largest financings in a varied lineup of large startup funding rounds.
business.why: Tracking hardware and lab investments highlights where specialized compute capital is flowing.

business.title: Startup Deals Highlight Robot Training, Space Lasers And Greener Cement
business.summary: This month's crop of interesting startup deals spans robot training for household chores and laser satellite tracking.
business.why: Emerging robotic embodiment and physical AI deals point to new application domains.

models.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash delivers native multimodal mixture-of-experts capabilities
models.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash supports text, image, and video inputs with a context window of up to 1M tokens, using sparse attention and speculative decoding to improve efficiency.
models.why: It introduces long-context multimodal processing suitable for advanced computer use workflows.

models.title: Sage-A1.5 agentic model advances long-horizon scientific problem solving
models.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model based on Qwen3.6 and Agents-A1, built to organize work and revise its approach during execution.
models.why: It offers an advanced open architecture for tackling complex, multi-step scientific and coding problems.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 improves reasoning, coding, and visual benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 delivers substantial updates across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length.
models.why: It helps engineers complete tasks faster and at a lower cost.

models.title: MOSS-Image-SFT improves text grouping and whiteboard layouts
models.summary: MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for text placement and object arrangement.
models.why: It provides better control over layout organization in generated images.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B post-trained model weights released for open inference
models.summary: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for Qwen3.8-27B in the Hugging Face Transformers format, compatible with vLLM and SGLang.
models.why: It expands options for running scalable, high-performance open language models.

models.title: Recursive Flint introduces a mixture-of-experts model for coding agents
models.summary: Flint is a 39.8B parameter mixture-of-experts language model designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests, with 2.5B active parameters per token.
models.why: It provides a robust local engine option for coding agent workflows.
